description.narrative: Inhabitants of Ndavaya in Kwale County in the coast region of Kenya are highly affected by unpredictable and extreme weather patterns. Longer droughts and heavier floods make it harder to sustain their traditional livestock and agricultural economy. The goal of the IKI Small Grants project was to support the development and implementation of a community strategy for increased climate resilience through interactive forum theatre. The theatre introduced concepts of climate resilience and reflected on communal hardships. Community members were invited onto the stage to act out their own decisions and interventions towards a climate resilient development path. Follow-up activities allowed the community to delve deeper into their solutions. The project seeked to create attitudinal change, building upon the community´s self-developed resilience. A total of 10,000 inhabitants were targeted, by either assisting the performance or participating in community environmental action days.
